tags.gist: Wants regulation to ensure accuracy in every medical decision made by a device without medical training that cannot lose a license.
Wants an enforceable off switch as a guiding principle, likening it to the switch that turns off an android in Star Trek.
Says the bar must be higher for AI that replaces a doctor's decisions than for people who went to medical school and got licensed.
